{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for loyal customers
loyal_customers = sales[sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Check the number of loyal customers
n_loyal = len(loyal_customers)

# Check how many of them converted
converted_loyal = loyal_customers['converted'].sum()

# Compute the fraction
fraction_converted = converted_loyal / n_loyal

# Print results
print(f"Number of loyal customers: {n_loyal}")
print(f"Number of converted loyal customers: {converted_loyal}")
print(f"Fraction converted: {fraction_converted}")"}
